spec.name: Orange Pets bed_wood
spec.description: A low woodland pet bed with a carved dark oak frame, subtle recessed wooden paw motifs, a soft sage-green cushion and the original cream pillow. Preserves the open front and 14×14 footprint, grounded at y=0, with decorative rear posts reaching 5.5 units.

prompt: Refine this pet bed into a special decorative woodland bed with a carved dark oak frame, subtle wooden paw-print details and soft sage-green cushion. Same one-block footprint, base y=0 and low shape no higher than 6 model units. Vanilla Minecraft pixel textures, no pet or scene.
